description: Environment setup and green baseline. Confirm the toolchain works and the project builds/tests cleanly BEFORE making changes, and create the feature branch so all work is committed off main.
steps: Ensure Node is on PATH: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH" (node v22.23.3, npm 11.x).
From /projects/sandbox/kiro-athen, confirm dependencies are installed (node_modules present, package-lock.json committed). If anything is missing run `npm ci`.
Create and check out a NEW feature branch off main: `git checkout -b feat/trail-coloring-and-course-editability`. Do NOT commit on main.

Run the baseline: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test`, `npm run build`. Record the results. Note that there are 6 PRE-EXISTING eslint warnings in untouched files - capture the exact baseline count so later features do not add new ones.
acceptance_criteria: A new branch feat/trail-coloring-and-course-editability (off main) is checked out; `git branch --show-current` confirms it and `git status` is clean.
`npm run build` succeeds on the untouched checkout.
`npm test` passes on the untouched checkout.
Baseline lint warning count is recorded (expected 6 pre-existing warnings).
verification: npm run lint  (record warning count baseline)
findings: Environment: Node v22.23.3, npm 11.4.2 (after export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"). Dependencies already installed; no npm ci needed.
